route: Illustrative loop through connected OSM walkable ways, not actual GPS or a navigation recommendation. All statistics are design fixtures.
excluded: Buildings, private access, construction, service roads, steps. No user location data.
projection: D3 7.9.0 geoMercator + geoPath; route fit extent [28,22]–[372,350]. OSM closed outer rings normalized clockwise. SVG paths embedded offline in fragment.
routeDistanceFixture: 6.28 km / 36:25 / 5:48 per km; derived loop is 6277m rounded. Pace bins, HR and achievement examples are illustrative, not measured.
virtualJourney: 10 km cumulative target, schematic progress along OSM-derived geometry; not a real 10 km navigable course. No actual place visit claimed.
indoorVenues: running-map-venues.json: OSM-tagged example facility building centroids; manually chosen fixture, not measured user position or verification of treadmill facilities.
